name: Total spending
expression: DIVIDE(SUM('DrugYear'[SpendingCents]), 100)
description: Sum of reported gross spending, converted from integer cents. Keeps current drug and year filters; excludes rebates.

name: Prescription fills
expression: SUM('DrugYear'[Fills])
description: Original prescriptions and refills in the current filter context. Not unique people or standardized treatment courses.

name: Available products
expression: DISTINCTCOUNT('DrugYear'[DrugKey])
description: Products with a published spending observation in the current selection. Count the fact-table keys so unavailable years do not inflate the count.

name: Average spending per fill
expression: DIVIDE([Total spending], [Prescription fills])
description: Weighted average: selected total gross dollars divided by selected fills. Do not average product-level averages. Returns blank without a usable denominator.

name: Share of listed spending
expression: DIVIDE([Total spending], CALCULATE([Total spending], REMOVEFILTERS('Drug')))
description: Selected spending divided by all listed products in the same selected year(s). Clears drug filters only, including group, ingredient, brand and product.

name: Prior-year spending
expression:
VAR Y = SELECTEDVALUE('Year'[Year])
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Y), CALCULATE([Total spending], REMOVEFILTERS('Year'), 'Year'[Year] = Y - 1))
description: Previous calendar observation year for the same drug selection. Requires one selected year; 2020 has no 2019 baseline in this release.

name: Prior-year fills
expression:
VAR Y = SELECTEDVALUE('Year'[Year])
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Y), CALCULATE([Prescription fills], REMOVEFILTERS('Year'), 'Year'[Year] = Y - 1))
description: Published fills in the previous observation year. Missing history stays blank.

name: Prior-year average per fill
expression: DIVIDE([Prior-year spending], [Prior-year fills])
description: Prior-year gross dollars divided by prior-year fills within the same drug selection.

name: Spending change
expression:
VAR Current = [Total spending]
VAR Prior = [Prior-year spending]
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Current) && NOT ISBLANK(Prior), Current - Prior)
description: Current minus prior spending only when both are observed. Aggregate changes can include changes in product availability.

name: Spending YoY
expression: DIVIDE([Spending change], [Prior-year spending])
description: Reported spending change divided by positive prior-year spending. Blank for missing or zero prior spending, or an ambiguous year selection.

name: Fills YoY
expression:
VAR Current = [Prescription fills]
VAR Prior = [Prior-year fills]
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Current) && NOT ISBLANK(Prior), DIVIDE(Current - Prior, Prior))
description: Change in fill count over the prior year. A small starting count can produce a very large percentage.

name: Average per fill YoY
expression:
VAR Current = [Average spending per fill]
VAR Prior = [Prior-year average per fill]
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Current) && NOT ISBLANK(Prior), DIVIDE(Current - Prior, Prior))
description: Change in average gross spending per fill. Supply and mix affect this measure; it is not a standardized unit-price change.

name: Fill-volume component
expression:
VAR Valid = HASONEVALUE('Drug'[Product]) && HASONEVALUE('Year'[Year]) && NOT ISBLANK([Prior-year spending]) && NOT ISBLANK([Total spending]) && [Prior-year fills] > 0 && [Prescription fills] > 0
RETURN IF(Valid, ([Prescription fills] - [Prior-year fills]) * [Prior-year average per fill])
description: Volume-first component: (current fills - prior fills) × prior average spend/fill. Requires one product and two observed years. An arithmetic component, not a causal effect.

name: Average-spend component
expression:
VAR Valid = HASONEVALUE('Drug'[Product]) && HASONEVALUE('Year'[Year]) && NOT ISBLANK([Prior-year spending]) && NOT ISBLANK([Total spending]) && [Prior-year fills] > 0 && [Prescription fills] > 0
RETURN IF(Valid, [Prescription fills] * ([Average spending per fill] - [Prior-year average per fill]))
description: Second component: current fills × (current average - prior average). Includes supply and product mix; does not isolate a pure price effect.

name: Bridge residual
expression:
VAR Volume = [Fill-volume component]
VAR Average = [Average-spend component]
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Volume) && NOT ISBLANK(Average), Volume + Average - [Spending change])
description: Volume plus average component minus total change. Should be zero to the nearest cent when the bridge is defined.

name: Comparison context
expression:
VAR Prior = [Prior-year fills]
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), NOT HASONEVALUE('Year'[Year]), "Select one observation year to calculate annual growth.", NOT HASONEVALUE('Drug'[Product]), "Select one product for the spending-change bridge.", ISBLANK([Prior-year spending]) || ISBLANK([Total spending]), "Comparison unavailable: both current and prior spending must be observed.", Prior < 1000, "Small baseline: " & FORMAT(Prior, "#,0") & " prior-year fills. Growth percentages are sensitive to that starting point.", "Components reconcile before rounding. Average spending reflects supply and mix; the bridge is not a causal price estimate.")
description: Visible guidance for missing comparisons, multi-selection, and fewer than 1,000 prior-year fills. The threshold is an explanatory portfolio rule, not a CMS suppression rule.

name: Spending rank
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Total spending]), RANKX(ALLSELECTED('Drug'[Product]), [Total spending], , DESC, DENSE))
description: Dense rank within the user-selected drug population. Ties can produce more than ten products in the leading-ten-ranks chart.

name: Leading product spending
expression:
VAR Rank = [Spending rank]
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(Rank) && Rank <= 10, [Total spending])
description: Returns spending for the leading ten ranks, preserving slicer selection. Other products return blank.

name: Release products
expression: CALCULATE([Available products], REMOVEFILTERS('Drug'), REMOVEFILTERS('Year'), 'Year'[Year] = 2024)
description: Count of available products in the 2024 release, independent of report slicers.

name: Release observations
expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('DrugYear'), REMOVEFILTERS('Drug'), REMOVEFILTERS('Year'))
description: Count of nonmissing product-year rows across all five years.

name: Release reconciliation
expression:
VAR AllSpend = CALCULATE([Total spending], REMOVEFILTERS('Drug'), REMOVEFILTERS('Year'), 'Year'[Year] = 2024)
VAR GroupSpend = CALCULATE([Total spending], REMOVEFILTERS('Drug'), REMOVEFILTERS('Year'), 'Year'[Year] = 2024, 'Drug'[Drug group] = "GLP-1 / GIP")
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(AllSpend), "Refresh to load the public source", IF(ABS(AllSpend - 288667842058.40) < 0.01 && ABS(GroupSpend - 27513350127.66) < 0.01 && [Release products] = 3625, "PASS · 2024 source totals match", "REVIEW · source totals differ"))
description: Compares refreshed all-product and selected-group spending and the product count against independent Python/SQL source controls. This is a release-specific check, not a live-market completeness guarantee.
